instruction.text: Drag the commas to the correct places in the letter.

hint.text: We also use commas when writing messages like letters or e-mails. We write a comma at the beginning and at the end of a letter.

atoms.sound: Dear Grandma, School is going well. I am learning how to use commas. Lots of love, Charles
atoms.b:
Dear Grandma ((,))

School is going well. I am learning how to use commas.

Lots of love((,))
Charles

atoms.sound: Dear Mr Williams, The homework was very easy. Please make it more difficult next time. Sincerely, Maya
atoms.b:
Dear Mr Williams ((,))

The homework was very easy. Please make it more difficult next time.

Sincerely((,))
Maya

atoms.sound: Dear Molly, I can’t wait to come to visit you soon! We will have so much fun! Lots of love, Bobbie
atoms.b:
Dear Molly ((,))

I can’t wait to come to visit you soon! We will have so much fun!

Lots of love((,))
